scope: Proposition 3.1 (Bounded geometry) of the manuscript “Ramanujan-Arthur Decompositions of Cuspidal Functions at Full Finite Level” (preprints/Ramanujan-Arthur-Decompositions-of-Cuspidal-Functions-at-Full-Finite-Level-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 014 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b4b0cfe23007d159), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 19. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For a fixed split connected reductive group and fixed finite level, the following statements hold. (a) The number of rational isomorphism classes of bundles of instability at most b is bounded by C(1 + b)N , for fixed C, N. (b) There is a locally finite constructible stratification of the bundle stack such that, on a stratum where the automorphism group has dimension r, the stratum has dimension at most C − r. The same constant works for all Harder–Narasimhan types. (c) Suppose that a sequence of bundles En has meromorphic isomorphisms to its point- Frobenius transforms, or meromorphic automorphisms, with the nth modification of size at most bn. If the ratio of the instability of En to 1+bn is unbounded, a subsequence has a coarsening of the canonical reduction to one fixed maximal parabolic that these isomorphisms carry to its point-Frobenius transform, or to itself, respectively. The assertion holds over geometric points and is compatible with descent and iteration of the Frobenius isomorphism. All statements allow an arbitrary effective level divisor, including nonreduced divisors, and any fixed list of parahoric flags.
